title: Difference between 1st and 2nd world
textContentHtml:
2nd world was way ahead of the first one where technology is so ahead of his time that you can live a fiction in any form!

2. Connection to the OG world the creator's world!:

    I. The first time A sepereme was formed it was years before the new tech era in the current world. 

    Ii. It took him so many years and in between he actually interacted with the creator several times and helps him grow but the creator was always trying to hide the solution to his final test!

  Iii. He will eventually helps the creator to imagine several ideal scenarios where A can be the ideal A!

  Iv. Finally this A chooses the successor and transfers all his will to him! While may be giving the chunks of other parts of his power!!!!!¡!!!!!!!!!!

Just like the story when  duriyodhan was given the choice between krishna and his army!!! He chooses army and which led to the victory of Pandavas with krishna in their side!
